profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have always been fascinated by technology. As a lifelong gamer, I’ve tried to keep up with the newest games, programs and devices, watching how they improved people lives. The thing that always stood out to me about the tech industry, is how there is always so much potential to create something new and exciting, and to use that to help someone. Be it improve people’s quality of life, or helping them out of a jam, technology can be used to find a unique solution for them. From a young age, I knew I wanted to help people, and this industry showed me all the potential there is for making a difference through technology.

Today, I’ve made that passion my career. I hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology and Science, courtesy of the University of Texas at Dallas. I am currently a software engineer with State Farm, working to develop and configure new applications, in addition to optimizing existing programs and code to ensure efficiency and functionality. This experience has given me unique opportunities to improve my coding skills, learn and implement CI/CD in all of my work, all while ensuring that our consumers are happy and satisfied with the end product. 

In addition to my experience as a full time software engineer, I have also spent some time working as a cyber security analyst at Baylor Scott and White. In this position, I found myself conducting malware analysis and assisting with simulated email phishing campaigns that enhanced employee awareness. This opportunity was priceless, as it placed me in a position to really interact with other employees and help to protect the company as a whole from threats and other potential security issues. 

I have been exposed to a number of programming languages, mainly Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and some light experience working with Python and SQL. My plans for the future are to become more proficient in the programming languages I mentioned above, but to also work towards being certified in Security+ . I am currently working on achieving my AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification.

My overall focus for my professional career at this point in time is to continue learning and growing my skill set. One of my hopes are to get more involved in the cybersecurity industry. As I’ve mentioned before, helping people and interacting with technology are my two major reasons for becoming an IT professional. I believe that there is no greater feeling than to help and protect others, and I believe that my future in doing that to the best of my ability  lies within the cybersecurity workspace.

projects.title: Email Quote Implementation
projects.description: Assisted in the creation and implementation of the email quite functionality, using the dependency injection framework, RESTful web services, and database schemas.

projects.title: Unleash Feature Toggle Integration
projects.description: Assisted in the integration of the Unleash feature toggle framework into the Drive Safe and Save application. This allows developers the ability to toggle on/off certain sections of code in the test environment. This project further enhanced DevOps and continuous development, as it allow developers to easily test out new features to see their impact and inspires them to only work on small bits of code.
